info.name: Marketplace - Customer API
info.description:
Customer-facing API collection covering every route in routes/api_customer.php.

Base path (country-scoped): `/api/customer/v1/{country}/...`
Base path (country-agnostic): `/api/customer/v1/...`

Auth: JWT Bearer token via guard `customer`. Obtain via Auth > Login or Register, then the `access_token`/`refresh_token` collection variables are auto-set by the test scripts on Login/Register/Refresh Token.

Standard success envelope (App\Http\Responses\ApiResponse): `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`
Standard error envelope: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": {...} }`
Laravel FormRequest validation errors (422) use the default shape: `{ "message": "...", "errors": { "field": ["msg"] } }`

Stub endpoints (return HTTP 501 Not Implemented for every request) are grouped into folders suffixed '(stub)': OTP (v1), Reviews (v1) store/mine, Device Tokens (v1) store, and Misc > List Shipping Methods (v1).
